About Zeta 
Zeta is a globally recognized next-gen banking technology company. Our modern platforms enable financial institutions and fintechs to launch extensible and compliant banking asset and liability products spanning cards, loans, and deposits. Our cloud-native and fully API-enabled stack supports processing, issuing, lending, core banking, fraud, loyalty, digital banking, and agentic AI solutions amongst many other capabilities. 
Zeta has 1700+ employees with over 70% in technology roles across locations in the US, Middle East, and Asia, representing one of the largest and most capable teams ever assembled in banking tech. Globally, customers have issued 30M+ cards on Zeta's platform expected to grow to 60M+ in the coming years. Most recently valued at $2B, Zeta counts Softbank, Mastercard, and Optum amongst its investors. 
 About the Role 
Zeta is currently laying the foundations for and incubating multiple new business lines in the US across multiple areas that include prospective customers such as fintechs, sponsor banks, banking solutions for non-banks and more. This effort is being led by Zeta’s Chief Business Officer who is looking to bring on board an enterprising individual to assist with all aspects of these GTM motions.  
This is a hands-on individual contributor role reporting to the CBO, with strong ownership of the operating rhythm across the CBO's full remit: strategy and planning, hiring & training, cross-functional program management, Sales & BD support, sales engineering & enablement, and marketing narrative. 


Responsibilities 
Strategic planning and operating cadence 

• 

Own the CBO's planning calendar: quarterly OKRs, board and leadership-team materials, and the narrative that ties disparate initiatives into one story 

• 

Turn a strategic direction into a written plan with owners, milestones, and a decision log, and chase it to completion rather than to a slide 

• 

Prepare the CBO for every high-stakes room, investor updates, executive reviews, by sharpening arguments & perspectives 

Cross-functional program management 

• 

Run point on flagship, cross-functional programs spanning various GTM, delivery, and tech functions, where no single function owns the outcome end to end 

• 

Unblock stalled work by finding the actual decision-maker and getting a decision, not a status update 

• 

Build the reporting rhythm, dashboards, weekly reviews, escalation paths, that lets the CBO manage by exception rather than by memory 

0-to-1 business building 

• 

Assist with standing up new business lines, partnerships, or markets from a one-paragraph thesis: market sizing, business case, initial plan, and the first few actions 

• 

Operate without a playbook or precedent, and write the playbook as you go so the next 0-to-1 motion starts faster 

• 

Know when to kill a 0-to-1 bet early rather than let it drift on inertia 

BD and partnerships support 

• 

Support deal structuring, diligence, and negotiation prep for new partnerships and strategic relationships 

• 

Own the follow-through after a deal signs: the handoff to the functions that will run it, and the check that it delivers what was promised 

Marketing, research, and narrative 

• 

Shape the external and internal narrative for major announcements, positioning shifts, and thought leadership tied to the CBO's initiatives 

• 

Partner with Marketing to convert field and partner evidence into content and messaging: what a partner program needs next, what a bank objected to, what changed a deal 

• 

Produce research, reports, analysis, commentary, and PoV to support the above 

Analysis and decision support 

• 

Build the models, market maps, and competitive analyses that back executive decisions, at a rigor that survives a board's questions 

• 

Turn ambiguous, half-formed asks into a structured problem with a recommendation and clear narrative 

Acting as the CBO's proxy 

• 

Represent the CBO's office in cross-functional rooms, partner meetings, and internal reviews the CBO cannot attend, with standing authority to speak for the office's position 

• 

Know which decisions must go back to the CBO and which can be made and reported

Key Performance Metrics 
Success in the initial 18 months is measured in two parts. The first is what you build, and it is yours alone. The second is what you contribute to, alongside the functions the CBO's office touches. 

What you build and own: 

• 

An operating cadence, OKRs, program reviews, a decision log, that runs without the CBO chasing it, covering at least three concurrent cross-functional programs 

• 

At least one 0-to-1 business motion carried from a one-paragraph thesis to a running initiative with its own plan and owner 

• 

A reporting and escalation system that surfaces a stalled cross-functional decision before it slips a quarter, not after 

• 

A written playbook for standing up a new business line, partnership motion, or program, reusable by the next person who has to do it 

What you contribute to: 

• 

Faster time-to-decision on cross-functional bets currently gated by the CBO's calendar 

• 

At least one strategic partnership or program taken from thesis to signed terms 

• 

Board and leadership materials that ship on schedule and hold up under questioning, across at least two board or investor cycles 

• 

Narrative and marketing work that changes how a partner or the market describes the company's position, traced to a named announcement or campaign

Skills 
• 

Translation: convert an ambiguous strategic direction into a plan with owners, milestones, and a decision log 

• 

Payments and banking fluency: enough command of how card issuing, processing, and lending businesses make money to build the case without asking someone else to check the math 

• 

Program discipline: run several cross-functional workstreams at once without dropping the one that isn't on fire yet 

• 

0-to-1 judgment: build a business line from a one-paragraph thesis, and know when to kill it instead of defending it 

• 

Analytical rigor: build models and analyses that survive a board's questions, not just a first read 

• 

Influence without authority: move work across functions you do not manage, on the strength of the argument and the relationship, not the org chart 

• 

Written communication: memos and decks that make the CBO's argument for them, not just record it 

• 

Discretion: handle information that touches deal terms, board discussions, and partner relationships before either is public 

• 

AI-Native: significant understanding of and established personal workflows and harnesses across writing, research, program management, and more

Experience and Qualifications 
• 

12+ years of experience spanning more than one of strategy consulting, investment banking, program or product management, and business operations focused on high-tech 

• 

Prior experience in payments or banking is required: card issuing, processing, lending, or core banking, with enough fluency in how these businesses make money to build a credible business case unassisted 

• 

Strong program management and/or top-tier management consulting experience, with a demonstrated record of running multiple cross-functional workstreams to completion against a tight deadline 

• 

A track record of building something from zero, a business line, a partnership, an internal function, with nothing but a mandate to start from 

• 

An engineering degree plus an MBA from a top-tier institution is preferred

We’re Hiring: Senior / Lead Product Analyst 
Location: Noida / Bangalore

Are you a strategic thinker with a passion for data, user insights, and product optimisation? We're looking for a Lead Product Analyst to join our dynamic team.

As a Lead Product Analyst at PhysicsWallah, you'll be at the forefront of driving product decisions through data-driven insights, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and shaping the future of our product offerings. If you're excited about working in a fast-paced environment, leading analytical initiatives, and making a direct impact on product development, we want to hear from you!

What you’ll do:
- Lead initiatives to inform product strategy and decision-making
- Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, and Business Stakeholders to define key metrics and KPIs
- Design and implement data collection processes and reporting frameworks
- Provide actionable insights from A/B tests, user behaviour analysis, etc.
- Mentor and guide a growing team of junior product analysts

Key Qualifications:
- 3+ years of experience in analytics within e-commerce, gaming, or edtech, with at least 2 years in a senior analyst role
- Strong proficiency in SQL, Python/R, and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau)
- Hands-on experience with A/B testing, cohort analysis, and KPI development
- Proven ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable business insights
- Excellent communication skills and experience working cross-functionally

As an Associate Recruiter on our Talent Discovery team, you will have the unique opportunity to become a hiring subject matter expert across all areas of our business, recruiting for technical to non-technical roles alike. Pivoting to support critical positions as they arise across the company, Associate Recruiters will focus on both passive talent sourcing as well as full-lifecycle recruiting. In this role, you will be expected to quickly upskill in new role profiles while maintaining a constant focus on cultivating a robust pipeline of aligned talent as an expert in numerous impactful sourcing tactics. This opportunity is ideal for individuals who embrace change, thrive in a dynamic, ever-evolving environment, and are excited to advance their career in technical recruiting. 

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

Shift: 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM IST

In this role, you will

  • Support critical MongoDB roles through strategic passive talent sourcing, quickly pivoting to support new areas of MongoDB’s business as hiring needs arise
  • Provide full lifecycle recruitment support for a variety of positions across the company, ranging from highly niche technical roles to non-technical functions
  • Work closely with hiring managers to understand business needs and deliver qualified talent accordingly, becoming an expert in the external market and a consultative talent advisor for business stakeholders
  • Partner with coordinators, hiring managers and interviewers to deliver an exceptional candidate experience, maintaining a high-touch and personalized process for all candidates
  • Support an equitable and inclusive hiring process for all candidates by educating stakeholders on hiring best practices and unconscious bias in decision-making
  • Conduct talent mapping, competitive intelligence research, and focused pipelining to support ever-changing business needs
  • Help build and evolve our long-term candidate engagement strategies at MongoDB, maintaining ongoing contact with a broad talent community of prospects for consideration for future rules

The right person for this role will

  • Have a passion and excitement for building a career in technical recruiting;  expertise in passive candidate sourcing for either technical or sales-focused roles is preferred but not required Previous experience in a technology-focused organization is a plus
  • Showcase a strong knowledge of robust sourcing tactics and best practices to identify a broad top-of-funnel pipeline
  • Maintain creative and out-of-the-box sourcing techniques to tap into new pools of talent, while uncovering new tactics through research and knowledge-sharing with peers
  • Have an analytical mindset, with the ability to conduct autonomous research and utilize data to inform strategy and influence stakeholders
  • Exhibit exceptional organizational and time-management skills, with previous experience in high-volume business environments. A proven ability to juggle multiple competing priorities simultaneously while navigating ambuiguity is required for role success
  • Maintain exceptional written and verbal communication, with business-level fluency in English
  • Proficiency working in Greenhouse and Gem is preferred, but not required

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

Elastic, the Search Analytics company, is seeking a dynamic Talent Sourcer. To excel as a Talent sourcer at Elastic, you need a blend of high-level technical curiosity and the gravitas of a Go To Market Expert. Because Elastic isn't just a "product" but a versatile search, observability, and security platform.  

We are seeking a Talent Sourcer with a strong track record in. As a Talent Sourcer, you will have the freedom to invent sourcing strategies to find the best quality possible in the APJ & EMEA region. This is a high-impact role for someone who loves working with recruitment, candidates and senior stakeholders in the complete region

What You Will Be Doing

  • Strategic Partnership: Partner with hiring managers and recruiters to deeply understand the requirements and nuances of roles across GTM – Management - Services
  • Full-Spectrum Sourcing: Build robust talent pipelines across multiple business units, maintaining the flexibility to shift focus based on evolving regional priorities
  • Engagement & Outreach: Utilise tools such as Greenhouse and LinkedIn Recruiter to develop personalised, high-conversion outreach that clearly communicates our value proposition and unique challenges
  • Seamless Coordination: Work closely with recruiters & Business to ensure a premium candidate experience.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay updated on industry trends, APJ market insights, and talent acquisition best practices, sharing actionable recommendations with the wider recruiting team

What You Bring

  • Sourcing Expert: You bring a proven track record of sourcing talent across the APJ & EMEA region. 
  • You have a solid background in IT talent sourcing, ideally with a blend of in-house and agency experience
  • Relationship Builder: You build trust-based relationships across the business to passionately connect professionals with roles that align with their experience and motivations
  • Highly Organised: Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Creative Problem Solver: You enjoy the challenge of finding "the needle in the haystack" and think creatively to identify and engage top-tier talent in competitive markets
  • Knowledgeable: You have a deep understanding of the regional talent market for technology, professional services, and corporate functions, along with a firm grasp of relevant employment laws
  • Data-Driven: You are comfortable using data and market intelligence to influence hiring decisions and refine overall sourcing strategies

 

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

  • Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
  • Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
  • Generous number of vacation days each year
  • Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
  • Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
  • Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.

We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email candidate_accessibility@elastic.co. We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.

About Druva
Druva is the resilience foundation for the AI enterprise, helping organizations secure and recover from connected risk across data, cyber, identity, and AI. The Resilience Cloud is a fully managed, cloud-native SaaS platform that delivers air-gapped and immutable protection across cloud, SaaS, on-premises, endpoint, and edge environments. Powered by Dru MetaGraph, Druva’s graph-powered intelligence layer, the platform connects critical business context so customers can understand risk, respond faster, recover cleanly, and govern data with greater confidence.

Trusted by nearly 7,500 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 500, Druva helps safeguard the critical information and systems businesses depend on in an increasingly connected world.

Visit druva.com and follow us on LinkedIn, X and Facebook.

The Druva Product Platform team builds the shared application platform that every Druva product is built on — the multi-tenant services, APIs, and control-plane capabilities that handle tenant lifecycle and provisioning, identity and access, authorization, configuration, orchestration and job scheduling, metering, and platform-wide observability. When a new workload or product line ships at Druva, it ships on top of what this team owns. That makes the work high-leverage and high-blast-radius in equal measure: the services you own are multi-tenant, always-on, and measured against strict availability and latency objectives, at a scale of thousands of enterprise customers and billions of operations per year.

As Manager, Engineering, you will lead a team of 10 to 13 engineers responsible for delivering features and enhancements for scale-out distributed systems and applications on the Druva Product Platform. The role requires involvement across the full product development lifecycle — from product roadmap planning, requirements specification, design, delivery, test, documentation, and release management, through to support and maintenance of what you ship in production. In addition, you will be responsible for talent management activities including mentoring, feedback through regular 1-1s, performance appraisals, and career development for your team.

Key Skills:

  • 10-15 years of experience with a consistent track record in development projects involving product development, as both an individual contributor and a team/tech lead.
  • 2 years managing a team of 5+ engineers, including experience managing, motivating, developing/coaching, and appraising the team assigned to the project.
  • Experience leading the development of complex, scale-out, distributed systems based on Service Oriented Architecture/Microservices (preferred).
  • Understanding of modern programming languages such as Go/Python and concepts such as multi-threading, concurrency, data-intensive applications, and NoSQL databases.
  • Demonstrated experience building and operating multi-tenant SaaS services — service APIs (REST/gRPC), asynchronous and event-driven workflows, and data stores at scale.
  • Experience owning services in production: availability and latency objectives (SLI/SLO), on-call, incident response, and root cause analysis.
  • Understanding of cloud technologies (AWS / Azure preferred; GCP also relevant) and of containerized deployment (Docker, Kubernetes).

Desirable Skills:

  • Demonstrated experience building products in the areas of Cloud/SaaS services, Storage, Virtualization, or Networking/Security.
  • Experience with platform concerns that cut across products: tenant isolation, authentication and authorization, rate limiting and quotas, schema and API versioning, and safe migration of live tenants.
  • Exposure to data protection, backup/recovery, or cyber-resilience domains (RPO/RTO, retention, immutability).
  • Familiarity with security and compliance expectations for enterprise SaaS (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, FedRAMP).
  • Experience shipping AI-assisted or LLM-backed product capabilities, and the platform work that supports them.
  • Start-up development and/or management experience is nice to have.

Role And Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate with Product Management, UX and architects to come up with high level design for the features, estimates, plan and timelines for the delivery.
  • This is a hands-on role that involves understanding the product at a detailed level and contributing to design discussions and code reviews.
  • Define release scope in conjunction with Product Management, and own end-to-end delivery of new features and service releases, often in parallel.
  • Own the operational health of the services your team runs — availability, latency, and cost objectives — and drive on-call quality, incident response, and follow-through on root cause analysis.
  • Partner with the product teams that build on top of your platform: treat them as customers, set clear API and migration contracts, and manage change without breaking them.
  • Help with ongoing escalations as required, and establish lean engineering practices such as CI/CD, TDD, effective code reviews, and automated testing.
  • Track and report progress on a timely basis; flag risks early and come up with feasible mitigation plans.
  • Define the team structure, and hire and strengthen the team to support the product roadmap and company vision, working closely with Talent Acquisition.
  • Coach, mentor and provide regular and timely feedback to direct reports; set SMART goals, run performance conversations, and create individual development plans that groom talent for promotion and career growth.
  • Participate in customer and sales connect sessions for product feedback, and maintain strong awareness of the market and competing products.

Qualification:

  • B.Tech / B.E / M.E / M.Tech (Computer Science) or equivalent.
